# flow guard

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:flowGuard`](gmeow-flowGuard.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/flowGuard>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

The guard condition type on a control-flow edge. The actual truth evaluation (the condition expression, variable bindings, etc.) is solver-side ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); the ontology records only the condition kind.
